findings.title: RabbitMQ child endpoint XML incorrectly promises isolated or cloned topology

nodes.before_text: Creates an isolated endpoint configuration that shares the bus topology.
nodes.after_text: Creates an endpoint configuration; the built-in implementation shares message, send, and publish topology and creates new consume topology.
nodes.actual185_XML_before_node:
<member name="M:ViciOne.ServiceBus.RabbitMq.Configuration.IRabbitMqBusConfiguration.CreateEndpointConfiguration(System.Boolean)">
            <summary>Creates an isolated endpoint configuration that shares the bus topology.</summary>
            <param name="isBusEndpoint">Whether the configuration belongs to the bus endpoint.</param>
            <returns>The new RabbitMQ endpoint configuration.</returns>
        </member>

nodes.before_text: Creates a child endpoint configuration with cloned RabbitMQ topology.
nodes.after_text: Creates a child endpoint configuration with new consume topology and retained parent message, send, and publish topology references.
nodes.actual185_XML_before_node:
<member name="M:ViciOne.ServiceBus.RabbitMq.Configuration.RabbitMqEndpointConfiguration.CreateEndpointConfiguration(System.Boolean)">
            <summary>Creates a child endpoint configuration with cloned RabbitMQ topology.</summary>
            <param name="isBusEndpoint">Whether the child belongs to the bus endpoint.</param>
            <returns>The new child endpoint configuration.</returns>
        </member>

nodes.after_text: Returns the stored host and optional port representation, adding brackets around IPv6 hosts.
